messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Those results are inconclusive.
Taking sertraline late in pregnancy may raise the risk of newborn problems that need longer hospital stays, breathing support, and tube feeding.
It may also raise the risk of persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN), a serious lung problem.
Use in the month before delivery has been linked with an increase in the risk of postpartum hemorrhage.
Postpartum hemorrhage is heavy bleeding after birth.
The increase in risk is less than two-fold.
Stopping treatment is not automatically the safer choice.
In one study of 201 pregnant women with a history of major depression.
Those who stopped their antidepressant during pregnancy were more likely to relapse.
Those who continued were less likely to relapse.
This is a decision to make with your doctor.
Sertraline oral solution contains 12% alcohol.
It is not recommended during pregnancy.
This is because there is no known safe level of alcohol exposure in pregnancy.
There is a pregnancy registry that collects information on antidepressant use in pregnancy.
You can join by calling 1-866-961-2388.
Triples: [["sertraline", "has risk during pregnancy", "newborn problems requiring longer hospital stays"], ["sertraline", "has risk during pregnancy", "breathing support needed"], ["sertraline", "has risk during pregnancy", "tube feeding needed"], ["sertraline", "has risk during pregnancy", "persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN)"], ["sertraline", "has risk during pregnancy", "postpartum hemorrhage"], ["postpartum hemorrhage", "defined as", "heavy bleeding after birth"], ["sertraline", "has risk increase magnitude", "less than two-fold"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "stopping treatment is not automatically safer"], ["sertraline", "has study", "201 pregnant women with history of major depression"], ["sertraline", "has risk during pregnancy", "relapse of depression"], ["sertraline", "has recommendation", "decision to be made with doctor"], ["sertraline oral solution", "contains", "12% alcohol"], ["sertraline", "contraindicated in", "pregnancy"], ["sertraline", "has warning", "no known safe level of alcohol exposure in pregnancy"], ["sertraline", "has pregnancy registry", "antidepressant use in pregnancy"], ["pregnancy registry", "has contact information", "1-866-961-2388"]]
Relations: ["contains", "contraindicated in", "defined as", "has contact information", "has pregnancy registry", "has recommendation", "has risk during pregnancy", "has risk increase magnitude", "has study", "has warning"]
Answer:

completion:
contains: The subject substance is composed of or includes the component specified by the object entity.  
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used in the condition or situation specified by the object entity.  
defined as: The subject condition or term is characterized by or defined as the description specified by the object entity.  
has contact information: The subject entity provides or is associated with the contact information specified by the object entity.  
has pregnancy registry: The subject drug is associated with a pregnancy registry that collects information on the object entity.  
has recommendation: The subject drug is associated with a recommendation or guidance specified by the object entity.  
has risk during pregnancy: The subject drug is associated with an increased risk of the medical condition or event specified by the object entity during pregnancy.  
has risk increase magnitude: The subject drug is associated with a specific magnitude of increased risk, as specified by the object entity.  
has study: The subject drug is associated with a study involving the group or population specified by the object entity.  
has warning: The subject drug is associated with a warning or caution specified by the object entity.
